why.title: Why Getcar Travel?
why.subtitle: Four simple reasons.
why.fleet.title: Our own vehicle fleet
why.fleet.text: Transfers are never handed to another company. The car and the driver are both ours.
why.guide.title: Uzbek- and Russian-speaking guides
why.guide.text: Our guides speak Uzbek and Russian, so no question goes unanswered.
why.insurance.title: Official insurance
why.insurance.text: A medical insurance policy is issued for every traveller.
why.manager.title: One manager
why.manager.text: You deal with the same person from start to finish. Nothing has to be explained twice.
how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Four steps. The first one takes a minute.
how.step1.title: You send an enquiry
how.step1.text: Fill in the form or write to us on Telegram. A phone number is all we need.
how.step2.title: A manager gets in touch
how.step2.text: During working hours we call back within 15 minutes and answer your questions.
how.step3.title: You choose and confirm
how.step3.text: We settle the dates, the hotel and the price. Everything is confirmed in writing.
how.step4.title: You pay
how.step4.text: Your manager sends a Payme or Click link, or you can pay cash at the office.
how.paymentNote: Please note: the site does not take payments. The payment link is sent by your manager.

about.title: About us
about.lead: Getcar Travel is a travel company based in Tashkent. We arrange package tours: hotel, transfers, insurance and guide services.
about.mission.title: Our approach
about.mission.text: Travel should not be complicated. You deal with a single manager, the price is stated clearly from the start, and no unexpected costs appear along the way.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.collect.title: What data we collect
privacy.collect.text: The forms on this site collect only what you enter yourself: your name, your phone number and, if you choose to add them, your email address and the text of your message. No other data is collected.
privacy.use.title: Why we use it
privacy.use.text: Only to answer your enquiry and to arrange your trip. We do not use your data for marketing emails and we do not sell it to third parties.
privacy.share.title: Who sees it
privacy.share.text: Your enquiry is seen by our managers. The details needed to arrange the trip, such as the name on a hotel booking, are passed to the relevant service provider.
privacy.storage.title: Where it is stored
privacy.storage.text: Enquiries are sent to our internal Telegram chat and stored there. They are not posted to our public Telegram channel.
privacy.cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
privacy.cookies.text: The site uses Yandex Metrica to collect visit statistics. The service does not identify you personally. It collects general statistics only, and it starts only after you have given your consent.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.text: You can ask us to delete your data at any time. Get in touch using the phone number or Telegram below.
privacy.legal.text: The rules on storing personal data changed in 2026. A form that collects a simple name and phone number, as ours does, does not fall into the restricted category. Even so, if you have questions, please contact us.
